Actual Android reachability, owner-aware cleanup and Gboard privacy, job recovery, model and device gates remain open.

ownership.natune: The existing standalone NaTune/migration owner has its own worktree; no index or media-writer ownership is transferred.

gboard_evidence.bundle: gboard-alpha23-build-verification.json: worker-start, direct-loopback and access-point controls passed; two hosted builds matched every artifact member and the observed Android 36 jar hash. Future runner/dependency states and SDK archive correspondence remain open.
gboard_evidence.apk: gboard-alpha23-apk-verification.json: pinned public Gboard release signer checked and three patches applied; output API/native/asset inventory, direct-proxy references, fallback guards, original manifest and compiled loopback XML inspected statically. Worker-start definitions and method bodies were found; call sites and runtime behavior were not checked by that scan.
gboard_evidence.worker_cleanup: gboard-worker-ui-diagnostic.json: the actual cleanup method passed current-request and fake dismiss-failure controls, but cleared shared busy in a supplied stale-request/newer-owner state. This is a synthetic state, not a demonstrated Android lifecycle race or fix.
gboard_evidence.custody: GBOARD-ALPHA23-CUSTODY.md: one owner-only private Drive build ZIP passed full remote byte/hash readback, and its exact MPP and source inputs were verified in memory by the recovery tool. gboard_evidence.companion: companion-022-dev7-verification.json: 47 public controls and Android ARM64 cross-build passed; selected translation text is serialized as source data. The ZIP was privately archived and fully read back. bridge-identity-diagnostic-verification.json records the retained, unfixed lifecycle defect; its diagnostic remained ignored in the regular run.
gboard_evidence.not_proven: No actual keyboard/UI, microphone, full-v3 inference, Sol account request, installed behavior, stock-feature regression or rollback has been accepted.

A caller-bound Termux handoff that does not expose the bearer through loggable stdout, plus actual privacy-writer and tool-boundary evidence.

Bridge owner lifecycle: a changed command executable can misclassify a live owner, and observation errors collapse into absence; preserve the encrypted record and distinguish UNKNOWN before safe update or stop. See bridge-identity-diagnostic-verification.json.
Original job identity, cancellation, encrypted settlement and no-replay recovery when a start response or process is lost; the Dot review request is prepared but its route is unverified.
